source_handle: Local disinfection with povidone-iodine and local infiltration anesthesia with bistriol. After the anesthesia takes effect, the gums are separated, the teeth are loosened, and the tooth extraction forceps are removed. Routinely scrape the tooth extraction wound to remove inflammatory granulation tissue and apply pressure to stop bleeding.
